info.title: Cyrnel API
info.description: Cyrnel is a universal layer that connects AI agents and LLM applications to any external service, API, or device regardless of protocol or standard. It acts as an adaptive bridge between your AI and the outside world, enabling seamless integrations through code execution, async operation handling, and built-in observability and security controls.
